name: Dante
tagline: Thirteen souls fell in the wrong circle. Bring them home.
description:
Lucifer's delivery service dropped a crate of evil souls in a corner of Hell that is still being built. You are Dante, a little red devil, and you have to catch all thirteen and take them to the eighth circle. Levers open gates. Boats cross the lava. Platforms spin and hex corridors turn. Fall in and you come back. You cannot die.

On a phone the left half of the screen walks and a tap pulls a lever. First person uses the right half to look. On a computer it is WASD or the arrows, E or click for levers, Esc for the menu. There is a third-person game and a first-person game; pick at the start.

Send the invite and extra Dantes appear in the same Hell, each catching their own souls. You see the others as ghosts on the platforms. Playing alone is the original game.

Your progress stays on this device, inside the app.

An unofficial port of Dante by SalvatorePreviti, MIT-licensed. First prize at js13k 2022, overall and on mobile. Music by Ryan Malm after Beethoven. This copy adds the ghosts over a meeting.
